senses.gloss: (v. בָּסַר II a. בָּסַם) to be sweet, pleasant.
to gladden, to bring good tidings to; in gen. to announce.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 87a:8">Ḥull. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>מְבַשֵּׂר טובות וכ׳</he> I am bringing good news.

Sabb. 63ᵃ, v. בְּשׂוֹרָה; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְבוּשָּׂר informed of good news, assured. Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ top יהא מב׳ מחיי העו״הב he shall receive a message from the life in the world to come, i.e. he may be assured of salvation; Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ מכושר לחיי וכ׳ … (corr. acc.); Y. Shek. III, end, 47ᶜ יהא מב׳ שבן עו״הב הוא.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 46">Ex. R. s. 46</cite> <he>אתה מב׳ שמחלתי וכ׳</he> thou art informed that I have forgiven thee &c. Y. Ber. V, end, 9ᵈ; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be gladdened, to receive good tidings.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 42:1">Pesik. R. s. 42</cite> <he>נ׳ בבנים</he> he was assured that he would have children.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 47:8">Gen. R. s. 47</cite>; s. 53 <he>נתבשרה בחלב</he> she was assured that she would nurse her child. [V. <cite ref="B01012"><he>בָּסַר</he> II</cite>.]
